$description: DreamShip OS semantic layer, light theme: roles, every value an alias into the reference layer.

subtle.$description: Decorative separators only; never the only boundary of a control.

control.$description: Boundary that identifies a control (input, secondary button outline). 3:1 against every surface, WCAG 1.4.11.

selected.$description: Border of a selected item. 3:1 against every surface; distinct from the focus ring.

success.$description: Light success is jade-ink #0A7559 (5.05:1 on dawn mist). The kit prose's deep jade #0C8F6C reaches only 3.62:1 and is retired.
